was: USFS campground in Sam Houston National Forest on the West Fork San Jacinto arm of Lake Conroe. 28 sites for tents and RVs up to 28 ft, no hookups; picnic tables, grills, lantern posts, flush toilets, showers, potable water. First-come, first-served (pay on-site). Access road not suited to high-profile RVs and turnarounds are tight - fine for a 23-ft rig with care. --Claude

was: USFS Angelina National Forest campground on a wooded point on Sam Rayburn Reservoir; ~10 standard non-electric drive-in sites, vault toilets, small/primitive. First-come, first-served (Scan-and-Pay on site). --Claude

was: 5-site paved pull-through RV park behind the Andrews County Chamber of Commerce; 50/30/15 electric, potable water, dump station; 3-night max, register at the chamber during business hours. First-come, first-served (donations encouraged). --Claude

was: 20-acre City of Ballinger park on Elm Creek. 19 sites with 30/50-amp electric and water (no sewer); swimming pool, playground, mini-golf, restrooms, showers. First-come, first-served - call City Hall for availability. --Claude
note: 20-acre City of Ballinger park on Elm Creek. 19 sites with 30/50-amp electric and water (no sewer); swimming pool, playground, mini-golf, restrooms. Call City Hall for availability. --Claude

was: City of Childress park with 5 back-in RV sites, water and 30/50-amp electric, some with metal shade carports. Paid at a drop box, first-come first-served (no reservation system). Park has a pond with walking path, playground, and summer swimming pool. --Claude
note: City of Childress park with 5 back-in RV sites, water and 30/50-amp electric, some with metal shade carports. Paid at a drop box. Park has a pond with walking path, playground, and summer swimming pool. --Claude
